bio: The restaurant showcases the appeal of Japan through domestic ingredients. Its name derives from the word ‘kakan’, meaning ‘bold and fearless’, and the team takes on challenges boldly and without fear of failure. The dishes draw on experience in Italian cuisine while remaining unconstrained by genre. A Basque-style cheesecake made with onion is one of the restaurant’s standout creations. To finish, guests may be served dishes such as ramen made with house-made pasta or grilled onigiri, reflecting the kitchen’s playful creativity.
